Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I love this grill !  We came very close to buying another "disposable" grill that would last only 2 years or so.  Fortunately we decided to step up and purchase this Weber Spirit II.  It is solid, cooks all meats evenly, even in the corners (unlike the disposable grills we have had in the past where there are hot spots and cold spots).  Because it cooks evenly, I can actually put more meat on at a time.  The infinate temperature controls allow for more precise cooking and much more flavorful dinners!  It is also looks great on our deck.  We special ordered the Red color, well worth the wait.  Hopefully it makes it more than 2 years, like all the others.
Results.Title: Perfect size, cooks evenly

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Replaced a 15 year old Weber with new one couldn’t be happier. Just the fact old one lasted so long had no choice but to buy new one. Weber is everything they claim and even better.
Results.Title: Everything I expected in a Weber!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have used Weber products for years. I have a 14 year old 22inch charcoal kettle grill and a gas flat top grill that has to be over fifteen years old and they both are still growing strong!  They’ve outlasted four covered grills from other brands during that time. I’ve put off buying a Weber covered grill because of the slightly higher expense but it finally dawned on me that they are so reliable and long lived that it will actually be cheaper than buying another brand   And I am in love with this thing. The grilling surface has the most even heating than any other brand I’ve used.  It is easy to keep clean and a TEN YEAR WARRANTY!  My only regret is not buying the bigger one but at least I still have the flat top!
Results.Title: Even heating

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Easy to use with push-button starter and smooth heater controls.
Down side: Two wheel moving and no lift handle when trying to move around. Poorly made left side tray when stowing away. Wild animals love the drip tray. Fire-starting wiring too light and thin. (Had to replace broken fire-starting wire.) Have to use rope around WEBER cover after use even with closure pads with the light winds on our deck.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Actually, I like this grill so much I bought two. One I got awhile back, maybe a year, for the deck at our seasonal site camper. When our grill on the backyard deck at our house needed replacement we bought this grill again. Why? 

1) The size is perfect for us. Usually it's just the two of us, sometimes a few guests,

2) The Weber just cooks better and it's reliable, 

3) The Weber lasts forever. The only reason to replace one is because you're just tired of looking at it and want a change.


Great product! Keep up the good work.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill about 2 months ago now. I would certainly like to be able to say I am enamored of it. We replaced our stalwart 2 burner 2004 Genesis Silver, the grill my wife cut her grilling chops on. She does all the grilling, and any questions pertaining to it will be answered with her input/attributes. She is having a very difficult time setting the proper temperature with the three burners. She gets different results per use and is getting a little gun-shy about using the grill at all some days. For my part, I put the grill together and was very satisfied with the packing and quality of the components (but used assembly manual, not spacy "BILT" app). Two design elements irk me. One, the grease tray: I find one must get on their knees to re-insert the assembled tray into the squeaky, imprecise shelf. It binds and catches until viola, it finally slides home. Second, the fold-down tray, when used as the  maneuvering handle, pops out of its non-adjustable mounting lugs and makes moving the unit an adventure. Fit, finish, appearance are top drawer, as expected. It's a Weber.
Results.Title: Meh

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought a new Weber grill after trying another product that rusted out and fell apart after 2 years.  My new Weber is easy to use, light up easily, heats up fast and has a more uniform cooking area.  The Weber is much higher quality.
Results.Title: Back to Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought this a couple of months ago through Home Depot, which was a miserable experience but not Weber’s fault. The assembly took me about 3 hours by myself. The warming rack won’t fit, it’s the wrong size. The grill cooks excellently, though. I grill 4-5 times a week so there’s been ample opportunity for problems to show if they’re going to, and to date the grill runs like a swiss watch. I’ve also purchased the temp sensors and the rotisserie (which I use to grill prime rib up to 11 lbs. The Weber recipes are an excellent adjunct to the hardware and I have tried quite a few.
Results.Title: So far, so good

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.ReviewText: I bought a new Weber grill about a month ago and am very pleased with my purchase. Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Our previous weber propane grill lasted over 23 years and was still meeting our needs. My wife and I decided to use our tax refund to help us buy a new grill. The way the new grill was packaged is a work of art!  All the parts assembled perfectly, instructions are easily understood, and parts are well defined. The grill performs very good in all aspects. Extremely easy lighting, nice large knobs are excellent for adjusting temperatures, and of course the food tastes as you would expect coming off a Weber product.
Results.Title: A very good product as you would expect from Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
After having a Weber Genesis the Spirit II three burner took some getting use to I could control the temperature better on the Genesis keeping it between 350 and 400 degrees the Spirit consistently ran over 410 with three burners lit if I run two burners temp stays around 390 to 400 that is the setting on low other than that great grill.

Sincerely,

Wayne White

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
